steps.label: Projekt entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat nn5_aa nn5_ab nn5_ac nn5_ad nn5_ae > nn5.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q nn5.tgz)" = 90aedaad01bfd9a99ae6f89261ca18d8 ] && mkdir -p nn5old && mv src public nn5old/ 2>/dev/null; tar xzf nn5.tgz && ls public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render src/index.jsx P out5.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > render_time5.txt

steps.label: Ton anlegen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out5.mp4 -i mix_nn.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film5.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i peloton_film5.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy peloton_film5_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film5*.mp4 >> render_time5.txt
